F1: The new `prisma.workflowReminder.update` inside `catch` (lines 190-197) has no guard, so if it throws, the error leaves the loop and the rest of the batch is skipped.
F2: When an account is locked, `scheduleSMS` returns `undefined`; the new `else` branch counts that as a failure, and once `retryCount` passes 1 the row is deleted, so locked accounts lose their pending reminders.
F3: Reprocessing rows with no message or no destination until their send date is how the code already behaved before this change; the new cap just doesn't cover these paths, and the finding names no actual failure.
F4: Only the SMS path increments `retryCount`, so the unscoped delete affects no live rows today; the rest is about the stale comment and a magic number, which are style and docs points.
F5: reminder.retryCount + 1` writes back the value read at the start of the run, so two overlapping cron runs can lose an increment, which is a real race in the added code.
